methods.name: static NativeBuffer allocNativeBuffer(int size)
methods.comment: * Allocates a native buffer, of at least the given size, from the heap.

methods.name: static NativeBuffer getNativeBufferFromCache(int size)
methods.comment:
* Returns a native buffer, of at least the given size, from the thread
     * local cache.

methods.name: static NativeBuffer getNativeBuffer(int size)
methods.comment:
* Returns a native buffer, of at least the given size. The native buffer
     * is taken from the thread local cache if possible; otherwise it is
     * allocated from the heap.

methods.name: static void releaseNativeBuffer(NativeBuffer buffer)
methods.comment:
* Releases the given buffer. If there is space in the thread local cache
     * then the buffer goes into the cache; otherwise the memory is deallocated.

methods.name: static void copyCStringToNativeBuffer(byte[] cstr, NativeBuffer buffer)
methods.comment: * Copies a byte array and zero terminator into a given native buffer.

methods.name: static NativeBuffer asNativeBuffer(byte[] cstr)
methods.comment:
* Copies a byte array and zero terminator into a native buffer, returning
     * the buffer.

methodNames: static void copyCStringToNativeBuffer(byte[] cstr, NativeBuffer buffer)
